description: Recent TAO token transfers on Subtensor with transfer volume in TAO, from/to addresses, transaction hashes, fees, and block numbers. Requires TAOSTATS_API_KEY. Related tools on this server, for a different need: crypto_subtensor_events when you need Recent Subtensor chain events, optionally filtered; crypto_subtensor_evm_activity when you need Bittensor EVM activity monitor: recent blocks, transaction. Price: $0.005 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.
